philippines.description:

philippines.title: PH joins ABAC III with new member Kevin Tan
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines joined business leaders from the 21 APEC economies on Tuesday as the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) opened its Third Meeting in Bangkok, with newly appointed ABAC Philippines Member Kevin L.
